grammar.title: Only, merely with 仅/仅仅
grammar.explanation: 仅 (jǐn) or its doubled form 仅仅 (jǐnjǐn) means "only, merely" — a formal way to limit a number or scope, similar to 只 but more written in style. It usually comes right before the number or fact being limited.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jǐnjǐn shì yī gè kāishǐ.
